1.mascotDialogue: Once the expression's a tree, working her out is simple — solve both kids, then apply the operator at the parent. No precedence table needed at eval time. The shape's already got it sorted.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 8's the base case — a leaf just hands back her own digit. Lines 9 and 10 recurse into both kids before line 11 combines 'em. Bottom of the tree goes first, always.

3.mascotDialogue: 'Cause plus sits underneath times, she's forced to sort herself out first — that's precedence, shown as depth in the tree instead of some rule you gotta remember.

4.mascotDialogue: This bug hides well, mate, precisely 'cause multiplication doesn't care about order. Swap the operator to subtraction in your head, and this exact same shape starts telling porkies.
